pre_ipo_investors: 22 Pre-IPO Investors via 10 June 2022 equity transfers (RMB1,084m for 10.84%; e.g. Zhuhai Qixin, Gaoling Yurun, Xianjin Zhizao, Guoce Xiangchi, Xiamen Yuanfeng, Huashun Guangzhou, Shenzhen Jiusi, Zhongke Chuangxing, Thriving Capital ...)
Founding/substantial shareholders UP OPTOTECH (25.56%, described as 'only an investor') and Luster (10.22%) - not among the defined 22 Pre-IPO Investors
board_roster_reviewed: Nine directors: Wang Xinyang (Chairman/CEO, ED), Zhang Yanxia (ED, spouse), Wu Qinyun (ED/CFO) - management; Yang Yi (NED since Sept 2012) - co-founder and director/vice GM of Luster, a 10.22% founding shareholder; Chu Hairong (NED, June 2025) - director of UP OPTOTECH, 25.56% substantial shareholder; Xiong Jingying (NED, June 2025) - assistant to GM of UP OPTOTECH; Wang Xinlu, Xie Ning, Gao Teng (INEDs) - academic/industry, no link. None of the three NEDs is linked to any of the 22 defined Pre-IPO Investors.
rights_and_timing: Special rights of the 22 Pre-IPO Investors (information, repurchase, liquidation preference, MFN) were granted by the Selling Shareholders; no board seat, nomination or observer right is listed. All terminated June 2023 (information rights of four investors restored Jan 2025, terminate again on Listing). Three NED seats are held by representatives of UP OPTOTECH and Luster, which are founding shareholders/'investors' since 2012 but are not defined as Pre-IPO Investors and no nomination right is disclosed.

unresolved_reason: Board reviewed in full. The three NEDs are representatives of UP OPTOTECH (25.56%) and Luster (10.22%), the 2012 founding shareholders, which the prospectus never classifies as Pre-IPO Investors (defined as 22 investors from June 2022) and for which no appointment/nomination right is disclosed; it is a judgement call whether founding institutional shareholders count as 'pre-IPO investor institutions'. None of the 22 defined Pre-IPO Investors is linked to a director, but the prospectus has no explicit statement that they lack board/observer rights (only lists their special rights as information, repurchase, liquidation preference, MFN), so supports_0 is not established and supports_1 rests on classifying UP OPTOTECH/Luster as pre-IPO investors.
